ios.desc:
beorg is a to-do list, outliner and task manager that puts you in control. You can see what needs to be done on a weekly agenda from the moment you open the app. Create tasks and notes using the outliner, organize your files and manage anything from simple lists to complex projects.

Your data is stored in plain text Org mode files which can be synced using iCloud, Dropbox, WebDAV or any compatible app that supports folders. Organize your files into folders, and use beorg alongside other Org mode/plain-text apps and tools.

beorg is free to use with optional extensions available as individual in-app purchases – or become a beorg Premium subscriber to unlock everything.

Use beorg to:

* Create tasks, notes and structured outlines
* See a weekly agenda of everything going on
* Organize tasks and notes across files and folders
* Be notified when you need to get something done
* Quickly capture new ideas and things to do
* Check your agenda from your Apple Watch
* Export outlines of PDF
* Sync your plain text Org mode files using iCloud, Dropbox, WebDAV, a folder in another app or Box*

Key Features:

* OUTLINER: Create and edit tasks, notes and structured documents using beorg's outliner. Quickly change dates, status, priorities and tags, rearrange items, expand and collapse sections, and focus on the part of an outline you're working on.
* AGENDA: See what's coming up with a weekly agenda on your iPhone and iPad. Events from your Org files are shown alongside those from your calendar.
* CREATE TASKS: Create tasks from throughout beorg. Assign dates, status, priorities and notes, add tasks to your inbox or choose a file, and set them to repeat on daily, weekly, monthly or yearly intervals.
* FOLDERS: Keep your Org files organized into folders. Move files between folders directly from the Files tab.
* REFILE: Move headlines to a specific place in another file. Refile individually, or select multiple headlines from the Agenda or Tasks tab and move them together. Available as an individual extension or with beorg Premium.
* SEARCH: Search all of your tasks and use a simple query syntax to get exactly what you want. An in-app purchase allows you to save searches for quick access.
* TEMPLATES: Define templates for common types of items you create.
* NOTIFICATIONS: Have your iPhone or iPad notify you of upcoming scheduled items and deadlines. Tap a notification to go straight to the task.
